title: 해양경비법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01105:20141119:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the National Safety and Security Agency and its Affiliated Institutions) <No. 1105, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation. However, if any decree issued under Article 6 of this appendix is amended, and if such decree was promulgated before the effective date of this rule but has not yet taken effect, it shall take effect from the date of effect of the corresponding decree.

Articles 2 to 5 are omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Decrees) Items ① to <36> are omitted.

<37> The following amendments are made to part of the "Maritime Guard Law Implementation Rules":

Item 1 of Article 2, excluding the phrases "police officers belonging to the Marine Police Agency (hereinafter referred to as 'Marine Police Officers' in this article)," is changed to "police officers belonging to the National Safety and Security Agency."

Items 1 of Article 2 and the same article, Item 2, are changed to "police officers belonging to the National Safety and Security Agency."

Item 5 of Article 3, Item 2, is changed from "Director of the Marine Police Agency" to "Minister of the National Safety and Security Agency," and the same article, Item 3, is changed from "Director of the Marine Police Agency,

"Director of the Regional Marine Police Agency" or "Chief of the Relevant Marine Police Station" shall be replaced with "Director of the National Safety Agency, Chief of the Regional Marine Safety and Security Bureau, or Chief of the Relevant Marine Safety and Security Station."

Sections 38 to 41 are omitted.
